dvd_device.description: The block device path to the DVD drive.

output_format.description: The output format. Options: h (human readable), j (JSON), p (Perl hash), y (Python), r (Ruby), x (XML).

dump_types.description: List of information types to dump. Options: audio, cells, angles, chapters, subpicture, palette, video, all.

quiet.description: If true, suppresses the summary output (-q).

track_number.description: Specific track number to inspect (-t). Leave null for default behavior.
